mainText: Hello, Verona! Here is your daily dish. It is seventy-two degrees outside Verona City Hall tonight, which is a bit balmy for a Wisconsin summer night. With a dark New Moon and no visible space station passes, the clear skies are perfectly quiet. In local news, creative students have until July twenty-second to submit custom I Voted sticker designs. Also, early voting starts at City Hall on July twenty-eighth. In police news, a motorcyclist without a license plate fled an officer at high speed, blowing through red lights. Finally, Culver's is closed right now but opens in the morning at ten AM. Tomorrow's flavor is Snickers Swirl, so sleep tight, Verona!
